result:
The landing line is now in `task.jsonl` and I've posted the one-screen reply on the card.

The R2 copy is built but nothing is uploaded, because R2 isn't enabled on the account. It needs one click from you: R2 → Enable in the Cloudflare dashboard. Then run `npx wrangler r2 bucket create lew42-archive`, `node Server/ArchiveCopy.mjs --plan`, and `--apply`.

The plan covers 4,982 pictures (579 MB), which costs $0.00 a month inside the free tier. Writes are capped at 10,000 per run.
